name: Tasmota
description: Plaintext HTTP is the default/mainstream OTA path on ESP8266 (HTTPS is opt-in build flag); no payload authentication. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The OTA branch flashes firmware; ESP8266 uses the plaintext client and the optional ESP32 HTTPS mode is documented insecure. This is firmware scope, not a primary app updater.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.
